units.source_text: 两个女人瞧不起外行，以娼妓心术不正而自豪，一味向阿泷劈头盖脑地倾泻毒言恶语。

en.t: The two women looked down on amateurs, taking pride in the crooked ways of prostitutes, and poured a torrent of vicious abuse over Otaki.

units.source_text: 阿泷一声不响地转动着两只眼珠，发出闪闪的光芒。

en.t: Otaki said nothing, only rolling her two eyes, which gave off a glittering light.
